title.description: The slide's title, short, in English. On the cover (cover) it is a one-line subtitle that introduces the document.

bullets.description: The bullets. Their number follows slide.bullets (min, max). The cover, agenda, section and comparison slides have an empty list.

text.description: One short English sentence shown on the slide.

source.description: The address of the paragraph it rests on: one of slide.parts[].paragraphs.

quote.description: The sentence of that paragraph it rests on, copied word for word.

columns.description: Only on a comparison slide (comparison): exactly two, the left and the right column. An empty list for every other layout.

heading.description: The column's heading (the name of what it compares).

text.description: One short English sentence shown on the slide.

source.description: The address of the paragraph it rests on: one of slide.parts[].paragraphs.

quote.description: The sentence of that paragraph it rests on, copied word for word.
